## ACUTE NEUROLOGICAL DISEASE ASSOCIATED WITH LYME DISEASE
Neurological disease is a common manifestation of Lyme Disease that typically
occurs within weeks to months after the tick bite. Unilateral or bilateral
facial nerve palsy (Bell's palsy) can be treated with oral antimicrobials. Other
neurological manifestations, including meningitis, require treatment with
intravenous antimicrobials.
## Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases
## Duration of therapy
Treat for at least 14 days. Longer durations, up to 21 days for facial nerve
palsy and 28 days for other neurologic disease, may be required in severe cases.
## Treatment of isolated facial nerve palsy (Bell's palsy)
Preferred: ##Inpatient [Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
For pregnant patients or those with contraindications to doxycycline: [Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h ($) [R]](psjzid-amoxicillin-500mg-po-q8h)
## Treatment of neurological disease other than facial nerve palsy (Bell's palsy)
[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M]](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)
